evidence.statement: The 24-bp exact sequence GTACCTTTTGTATAATGGGTCAGC forms the first token of frozen cluster COL-0001, pairing E. coli start0 4,038,078 with yeast mitochondrial start0 58,467.
The yeast chrM start0 58,467 corresponds to 1-based 58,468, inside the independently recorded mitochondrial 21S_RRNA/Q0158 locus 58,009–62,447.
This is an unresolved exact bacterial↔mitochondrial primitive whose yeast-side context is known but whose E. coli context and exact mechanistic role remain UNKNOWN.
Post-freeze assembly-matched validation confirms the E. coli occurrence at start0 4,038,078 lies inside rrlA 23S rRNA.
LC-PRIM-0007 is therefore a validated exact large-subunit-rRNA-associated primitive shared between E. coli 23S rRNA and yeast mitochondrial 21S rRNA.
Published-sequence anchoring plus the previously frozen 1,370-bp spacing maps LC-PRIM-0007 to E. coli 23S rRNA positions 560-583.
This interval straddles the structure-based Domain I/Domain 0 boundary; Domain 0 begins at 562 and is a highly conserved central structural core of the large-subunit rRNA.
Coder alias: LSU_CORE_SCAFFOLD_EDGE — a conserved literal token spanning entry into the central LSU structural core.

unknowns: Assembly-matched annotation of the E. coli occurrence.
Mechanistic role of the exact 24-bp sequence.
